name: iae
title: IAE — Identification / Analysis / Evaluation
description: Research. Structures how sources are read and judged: every claim traceable to a locator, conflicts made explicit, conclusions carrying confidence and a falsifier.
use_when: Reading and reasoning over sources — evaluating a technology, a market, a claim, a body of literature. Not for building or automating; use doe for that.
blurb: structures thinking (reading sources, reaching a defensible conclusion)
